verdict.rationale: doola's own docs describe an annual-report filing capability: it reads what a state requires and charges, puts the company's annual report on file, confirms it, and tracks it to completion. A compliance calendar lists the recurring obligations doola tracks to keep a company in good standing. Missing for 10: evidence of a founder-facing annual-report add-on (the docs frame it through the Partner API), add-on pricing, detail on how reports are prepared, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
